name: botly
description: Botly: a team of Hermes agents, each with its own screen on one Orgo computer, with Composio apps and xAI voice.

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test:hardening: npm run build -w server && node --test tests/hardening.test.mjs tests/tavily.test.mjs tests/video-preview.test.mjs tests/agent-security.test.mjs && bash -n scripts/backup.sh scripts/provision-managed-agents.sh && bash -n scripts/update.sh && bash -n scripts/migrate-to-botly.sh && bash tests/backup.test.sh
